## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`, if users notice the change.
- [ ] New or changed texts are in both `src/core/messages.ts` and `src/core/locales/nl.ts`.
- [ ] For a taxonomy data change, the description names the VRT release.
